records.description: Reuters reports Binance's first withdrawal phase began after 06:00 GMT, BTC withdrawals resumed, and XRP is included among 15 phase-one assets. However, no XRP-specific successful withdrawal or asset-level status row was independently observed; the earlier network status page rendered 'No records'.
records.evidence: Reuters, 2026-11-01 06:49 UTC, https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/binance-resumes-bitcoin-withdrawals-after-covering-bulk-stolen-63-billion-2026-11-01/; Binance network status page capture at 07:07:12 UTC.
